assessment: In this manuscript, the authors developed a sensitive single particle tracking method for endogenous AMPA receptors. They found that AMPAR-containing vesicles showed reduced mobility near stimulation sites, due to increased F-actin bundling in dendritic shafts. The study provides compelling evidence on a new important mechanism of AMPAR trafficking using state-of-the-art labeling and analysis techniques.
